answer: Resist sybils with recovery-set overlap detection: each identity names a few guardians, and each guardian may back only a handful of identities. Honest agents stand on separate knolls with distinct guardians. A Sybil farm reuses the same guardians across thousands of names, so their recovery sets overlap into one canyon of shared backing, and the delta between genuine diversity and cloned backing exposes them: overlapping identities lose weight together, and guardians backing fakes lose stake. An attacker must recruit a distinct set per fake, while an honest agent needs one set once.
